fusions.name: Spun Fang
fusions.desc: Strikes the first enemy it meets for 12 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Strand Flurry
fusions.desc: Looses 3 strands spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 20% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hung Snare
fusions.desc: Conjures a snare onto the nearest enemy. It waits 2 minutes, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 28 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Felt Tremor
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
